title: Stamp Duty Land Tax Manual
summary:
Guidance on Stamp
Duty Land Tax (SDLT) which applies to land transactions in the UK from 1 December
2003. Since 1 April 2018 SDLT has applied to land transactions in England and
Northern Ireland only. 

Guidance for transactions in Scotland since 1 April 2015 can be found at theScottish
Government website. 

Guidance for transactions in Wales since 1April 2018 can be found at theWelsh
Revenue Authority.

title: Guidance: Report and manage your allowance for Customs Duty waiver claims: service availability and issues
summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the Report and manage your allowance for Customs Duty waiver claims service.

title: Claim a waiver for duty on goods that you bring to Northern Ireland from Great Britain or countries outside the UK and EU
summary: Find out how to claim a customs duty waiver if you are bringing goods into Northern Ireland from Great Britain or countries outside the UK and EU which might otherwise be charged ‘at risk’ tariffs.

title: Report payments and view your allowance for non-customs state aid and Customs Duty waiver claims
summary: Use the online service to report non-customs state aid payments you’ve received to HMRC and view your state aid allowance if you’ve claimed Customs Duty waivers.

title: Promotional material: Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps Scheme — communications resources
summary: These resources are designed to enable you to cascade accurate, timely information about the upcoming Vaping Products Duty and Vaping Duty Stamps Scheme to your members.

title: Transparency data: HMRC: spending over £25,000, July 2026
summary: Reports on departmental spending over £25,000.

title: How to claim a repayment of import duty and VAT if you've overpaid
summary: Check time limits and how to claim for your circumstances as an importer, agent or express operator. Use the Customs Declaration Service or form C285 as an individual.

title: Claim back an import security deposit or guarantee
summary: Use this service for Temporary Admission, inward processing or authorised use with an authorisation by declaration, or if proof of origin was not available at the time of import.

title: Check the recognised overseas pension schemes notification list
summary: Find schemes that have told HMRC they meet the conditions to be a recognised overseas pension scheme (ROPS).

title: Guidance: List of Individual Savings Account (ISA) managers approved by HMRC
summary: Find ISA managers approved by HMRC from October 2014.

title: Admin Law Manual
summary: Guidance on admin law covering incorrect advice to customers, collection and management, extra statutory concessions and statements of practice.

title: Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027
summary: Use these rates and thresholds when you operate your payroll or provide expenses and benefits to your employees.

title: Guidance: Transit newsletters — HMRC updates
summary: Check for the latest updates about moving goods using transit and the New Computerised Transit System (NCTS).

title: Sign up for the Trader Support Service
summary: If you move goods in or out of Northern Ireland the Trader Support Service will guide you through any changes due to the implementation of the Windsor Framework.

title: Check which packaging is subject to Plastic Packaging Tax
summary: Check what classifies as plastic, recycled plastic and packaging components, and if the packaging you manufacture or import is subject to the tax.

title: Preparing to use a mass balance approach for Plastic Packaging Tax
summary: Find out how your business can get ready to use a mass balance approach to account for chemically recycled plastic for the Plastic Packaging Tax.

title: Guidance: Minimum certification requirements for a mass balance approach for Plastic Packaging Tax
summary: Find out about the minimum certification requirements when using a mass balance approach for chemically recycled plastic from 1 April 2027.

title: Check if an email you've received from HMRC is genuine
summary: Check a list of recent emails from HMRC to help you decide if the email you've received is a scam.

summary: Check the availability and any issues affecting the Making Tax Digital for Income Tax service.
